title: Objective plaque analysis for prognosis assessment of severe carotid stenosis
summary: In this research project, we aim to develop imaging parameters for describing and assessing carotid artery stenosis. These parameters should enable an objective assessment of the severity of carotid artery stenosis and the stability of plaque deposits in the artery. This should facilitate individualized treatment decisions and improve patient outcomes.
conditions: Occlusion and stenosis of carotid artery

interventions.name: Patients with symptomatic carotid stenosis who were given an interdisciplinary indication for carotid endarterectomy at Mannheim University Clinic.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Indication for carotid desobliteration
• Consent to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion of patients is only expected in the event of organizational or technical problems relating to the preliminary examination. Refusal to participate is also a criterion for exclusion.
